SELECT ITEM_KEYWORD FROM OP_ITEM I
AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND ITEM_KEYWORD != ''
GROUP BY ITEM_KEYWORD

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM OP_KEYWORD WHERE KEYWORD_SEPERATION LIKE CONCAT(#{query},'%') AND KEYWORD_TYPE = '1' LIMIT 10
UNION
SELECT * FROM OP_KEYWORD WHERE KEYWORD_SEPERATION LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') AND KEYWORD_TYPE = '1' LIMIT 10 ) T LIMIT 10
